deterministic_settings.failure_policy: fail the run if a requested operation cannot satisfy deterministic algorithms; do not silently fall back

seed_schedule.seed_reuse_policy: A seed is used only for the declared purpose; do not add, omit, or reorder seeds.

data_order.within_split_order: run_id ascending, then realization_id ascending where needed
data_order.batch_order: ascending run_id; batch size 1 for TGNN

initialization.rule: Set all declared seeds and deterministic settings immediately before each candidate or repeated-seed model initialization.
initialization.model_initialization: Use framework default parameter initialization under the fixed torch seed; do not copy weights between candidates or repeated runs.
initialization.optimizer_initialization: Instantiate the optimizer after model initialization under the same run seed; optimizer state starts empty.
initialization.preprocessing_initialization: Fit training-only statistics once per experiment configuration and reuse the frozen transform for validation/test.

capture_requirements: record Python, OS, CPU, package versions, device, deterministic settings, environment variables, and git HEAD
record the exact command line and a complete stdout/stderr transcript
record split identities, source dataset manifest hashes, config hash, seed, candidate index, and selected checkpoint hash
SHA-256 hash every plan, configuration, model, prediction, metrics, transcript, and final report artifact
write an artifact inventory that is self-excluding and records relative paths, byte sizes, and hashes
rerun_rule: A rerun is a new declared run with the same frozen configuration and seed schedule; it cannot change a selection or test result after test opening.
